title: Louis Armstrong as novelty player
summary: Fragment on how New Orleans musicians view Louis Armstrong, the old-timers calling him a novelty player.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: You were talking about... Yeah, a lot of the Negroes down here, they're all crazy about him. They all try to imitate him. And yet occasionally you run across some of the old timers that'll say, well, he plays novelty music. It's not really good jazz.
